zones.name: The Study
zones.notes: Murder site. Braun only. Reachable only via entry and family_room. Exterior windows face the lawn.
zones.clue_spot: The scene itself. The bloody QR.

zones.name: Entry
zones.notes: The front door, the coat rail, and Bertram's post. The corridor to the study begins here — the one hallway everybody watches and nobody admits to using.
zones.clue_spot: The console table by the study corridor.

zones.name: Family Room
zones.notes: Family photos on the high shelf and Braun's collection cabinets. The quiet back route to the study runs through here, past a tea tray that never arrived.

zones.name: Kitchen
zones.notes: Leo's kingdom. Service traffic cuts through from the driveway, and the night's delivery paperwork piles up by the counter — signed by more hands than worked here.
zones.clue_spot: The service counter, among the delivery paperwork.

zones.name: Sitting Room & Stairs
zones.notes: Upstairs is roped off; the landing is visible from here.

zones.name: Grand Hall
zones.notes: The stage and the bar. At 9:40 tonight, every guest in the house was standing here, watching the singer. That was the idea.
zones.clue_spot: Beneath the front of the stage.

zones.name: Grand Hall Extension
zones.notes: Far end of the closed west wing. The most private room in the house.
zones.clue_spot: The bar crates and the storage door.

zones.name: Driveway
zones.notes: The side path wraps to the study side of the house. Access via side_path route.
zones.clue_spot: Around the parked cars and the side path.

zones.name: The Lawn & Gardens
zones.notes: The study's exterior windows face the lawn. Access via window route.
zones.clue_spot: The far garden bed and beneath the study windows.
